cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(seh_dispatch_test C)
# Guest exception dispatch on lifted code (XBA-112). fixture_gen.c is
# generated by tools/recomp/seh_fixture.py from fixture.s and checked in, so
# this builds anywhere the runtime does, arm64 included.
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
add_subdirectory(../.. runtime)
add_executable(seh_dispatch_test test_main.c fixture_gen.c)
target_include_directories(seh_dispatch_test PRIVATE
    ../../src/kernel ../../src ../../templates/runtime)
target_link_libraries(seh_dispatch_test PRIVATE xboxrecomp)
if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(seh_dispatch_test PRIVATE winmm)
endif()
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME seh_dispatch_test COMMAND seh_dispatch_test)

# What an anchor costs per call (not a test): ./seh_anchor_bench [iterations]
add_executable(seh_anchor_bench anchor_bench.c ../../src/kernel/xbox_seh.c
    ../../src/kernel/recomp_discovery.c)
target_include_directories(seh_anchor_bench PRIVATE ../../src/kernel ../../src)
target_link_libraries(seh_anchor_bench PRIVATE platform)
